body.name: Verified primal--dual reconstruction algorithm
body.construction: \(\mathsf{VPA}\) denotes the dovetailed exact-arithmetic enumeration of conforming rational midpoint refinements, rational-nodal members of \(\mathcal F_{d,h}\) satisfying the exact continuous cell moments, unrestricted rational multipliers, rational atomic plans in \(\Pi_{\le}(\sigma)\), and outward rational interval enclosures of \(D_d\).  Given a requested rational tolerance \(\epsilon>0\), its stopping rule returns the current certificates as soon as the primal--dual gaps for both arm endpoints are at most \(\epsilon\).
